paragraphs: Mentioned in Ketubot 60a: he said the halakha follows R' Yitzchak, who spoke in the name of R' Yochanan; and Hyman suggests that perhaps it should read Rav Shimi bar Abba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ס. gives 60a by convention without a fresh named passage. Yitzchak and Yochanan have abbreviated titles only and remain R'; both explicit Shimi titles remain Rav.
ואולי צ״ל preserves Hyman’s tentative Abaye-to-Abba patronymic correction, not an established reading or identity merge. The chain and ruling direction remain unchanged.
